title: German Spring Pasta Bake
description: A hearty and flavorful German-inspired pasta bake, featuring zesty spring flavors and a satisfying Croatian twist. Perfect for a family dinner or a cozy evening in.
instructions: Cook the spring pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper, cooking until tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the zesty Croatian cheese until melted and well combined.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to coat with the cheese and vegetable mixture.
Transfer the pasta mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped parsley.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is bubbly.
